PLAN "2-Week Travel Maintenance - Hotel Room"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "maintain muscle mass"

        warmup:
          jumping_jack 5m

          pull_up 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds

          shoulder_stretch 5m
